verdict.rationale: This is a category error: the AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a desktop CPU, and user-configurable background automations are not a capability a processor ships. The evidence covers only hardware tuning (Ryzen Master profiles, PBO, Auto Overclock, EXPO) and performance, with nothing resembling autonomous automation workflows. Ryzen Master's stored tuning profiles are performance configurations, not autonomous automations, so they do not make this axis apply.
